Name: AccessorySlots
Description:
Adds an extensible accessory slot system with slots for multiple body parts. You can add or remove global accessory slots via the config menu. SMAPI is required.

AI Disclosure: This mod is human-designed. AI was used only to assist coding, debugging and text polishing. All core design, architecture and logic are implemented and reviewed by myself.

Manifest.Name: 饰品栏 · Accessory Slots
Manifest.Description: 通用饰品栏框架：胸饰/头饰/项链/手镯/面部各 1 格、戒指 2 格、足部 2 格，通用栏位数可在 config.json 里改；格位与佩戴列表支持鼠标滚轮滚动。提供 API，其它模组可注册自己的饰品与格位。
Manifest.Author: LengFeng（原模组）· 拆分重构
